text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yaaahh!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Here and "now," I give my all—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ââHAAAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno & Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Gah!?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Mejiro Ardan!
Mejiro Ardan is out in front!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan crosses the finish line!!
The young lady of the Mejiro family has brilliantly claimed
the first crown of glory!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa...!
She's Mejiro Ramonu's younger sister, right?
Both sisters are seriously impressive!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, it makes me want to rewatch
the race where Ramonu won her first Tiara...
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(My heart is racing like never before...
This isn't something precarious
like during my debut race——)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(As if an inner fire blazes ever brighter...
it rouses and inspires my heart...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (But—)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(The sheer fighting spirit I felt from Yaeno-san and
Chiyono O-san during the race
is still lingering in my body...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Tighten your helmet strings after a victory, huh.

Going to greet Mejiro Ardan
after her magnificent victory—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I was able to put everything
I have right now into today's race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "Even though I've finished running, a new vitality is swirling within this body—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It is... deeply soothing.
choice_data_list: It's proof of how strong you've become.
It's proof that you've gotten stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Truly... it's all thanks to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I intend to run the next Aoba Sho with a performance that builds right upon today's result.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "Please... once again, I ask for your strict guidance and discipline."

The Aoba Sho is right around the corner.
She braced herself once more
to keep the momentum of good results going...!
Meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Today, I was in peak condition.
And I ran the absolute best race I could right now.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: However... I lost to Ardan-san—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
At the Japan Derby...
it won't go down like this...!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Next time, the one who wins... will be me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...*gasp*

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ardan-san was... truly incredible after all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "I'm sure she'll run even better in the Nippon Derby than she did today...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: However, even so—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —I've made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I want to become like her...
I want to catch up to her...
That's why...—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I vowed... that I would win
the race that person yearned for...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I can't afford to lose.
I can't be feeling down!
I can't be crying!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Next time, the one who wins... will be me!!

Carrying each of their feelings,
the Nippon Derby was drawing near—
